154: 	private JCMethodDecl createRecordArgslessConstructor(JavacNode typeNode, JavacNode source, JCMethodDecl existingCtr) {
155: 		JavacTreeMaker maker = typeNode.getTreeMaker();
156: 		
157: 		java.util.List<JCVariableDecl> fields = new ArrayList<JCVariableDecl>();
158: 		for (JavacNode child : typeNode.down()) {
159: 			if (child.getKind() == Kind.FIELD) {
160: 				JCVariableDecl v = (JCVariableDecl) child.get();
161: 				if ((v.mods.flags & RECORD) != 0) {
162: 					fields.add(v);
163: 				}
164: 			}
165: 		}
166: 		
167: 		ListBuffer<JCVariableDecl> params = new ListBuffer<JCVariableDecl>();
168: 		
169: 		for (int i = 0; i < fields.size(); i++) {
170: 			JCVariableDecl arg = fields.get(i);
171: 			JCModifiers mods = maker.Modifiers(GENERATED_MEMBER | Flags.PARAMETER, arg.mods.annotations);
172: 			params.append(maker.VarDef(mods, arg.name, arg.vartype, null));
173: 		}
174: 		
175: 		JCModifiers mods = maker.Modifiers(toJavacModifier(AccessLevel.PUBLIC) | COMPACT_RECORD_CONSTRUCTOR, List.<JCAnnotation>nil());
176: 		JCBlock body = maker.Block(0L, List.<JCStatement>nil());
177: 		if (existingCtr == null) {
178: 			JCMethodDecl constr = maker.MethodDef(mods, typeNode.toName("<init>"), null, List.<JCTypeParameter>nil(), params.toList(), List.<JCExpression>nil(), body, null);
179: 			return recursiveSetGeneratedBy(constr, source);
180: 		} else {
181: 			existingCtr.mods = mods;
182: 			existingCtr.body = body;
183: 			existingCtr = recursiveSetGeneratedBy(existingCtr, source);
184: 			addSuppressWarningsAll(existingCtr.mods, typeNode, typeNode.getNodeFor(getGeneratedBy(existingCtr)), typeNode.getContext());
185: 			addGenerated(existingCtr.mods, typeNode, typeNode.getNodeFor(getGeneratedBy(existingCtr)), typeNode.getContext());
186: 			return existingCtr;

190: 	/**
191: 	 * If the provided typeNode is a record, returns the compact constructor (there should only be one, but if the file is
192: 	 * not semantically sound there might be more). If the only one in existence is the default auto-generated one, it is removed,
193: 	 * a new explicit one is created, and that one is returned in a list.
194: 	 * 
195: 	 * Otherwise, an empty list is returned.
196: 	 */
197: 	private List<JCMethodDecl> addCompactConstructorIfNeeded(JavacNode typeNode, JavacNode source) {
198: 		List<JCMethodDecl> answer = List.nil();
199: 		
200: 		if (typeNode == null || !(typeNode.get() instanceof JCClassDecl)) return answer;
201: 		
202: 		JCClassDecl cDecl = (JCClassDecl) typeNode.get();
203: 		if ((cDecl.mods.flags & RECORD) == 0) return answer;
204: 		
205: 		boolean generateConstructor = false;
206: 		
207: 		JCMethodDecl existingCtr = null;
208: 		
209: 		for (JCTree def : cDecl.defs) {
210: 			if (def instanceof JCMethodDecl) {
211: 				JCMethodDecl md = (JCMethodDecl) def;
212: 				if (md.name.contentEquals("<init>")) {
213: 					if ((md.mods.flags & Flags.GENERATEDCONSTR) != 0) {
214: 						existingCtr = md;
215: 						existingCtr.mods.flags = existingCtr.mods.flags & ~Flags.GENERATEDCONSTR;
216: 						generateConstructor = true;
217: 					} else {
218: 						if (!isTolerate(typeNode, md)) {
219: 							if ((md.mods.flags & COMPACT_RECORD_CONSTRUCTOR) != 0) {
220: 								generateConstructor = false;
221: 								answer = answer.prepend(md);
222: 							}
223: 						}
224: 					}
225: 				}
226: 			}
227: 		}
228: 		
229: 		if (generateConstructor) {
230: 			JCMethodDecl ctr;
231: 			if (existingCtr != null) {
232: 				ctr = createRecordArgslessConstructor(typeNode, source, existingCtr);
233: 			} else {
234: 				ctr = createRecordArgslessConstructor(typeNode, source, null);
235: 				injectMethod(typeNode, ctr);
236: 			}
237: 			answer = answer.prepend(ctr);
238: 		}
239: 		
240: 		return answer;
241: 	}

243: 	private void addNullCheckIfNeeded(JCMethodDecl method, JavacNode paramNode, JavacNode source) {
244: 		// Possibly, if 'declaration instanceof ConstructorDeclaration', fetch declaration.constructorCall, search it for any references to our parameter,
245: 		// and if they exist, create a new method in the class: 'private static <T> T lombok$nullCheck(T expr, String msg) {if (expr == null) throw NPE; return expr;}' and
246: 		// wrap all references to it in the super/this to a call to this method.
247: 		
248: 		JCStatement nullCheck = recursiveSetGeneratedBy(generateNullCheck(source.getTreeMaker(), paramNode, source), source);
249: 		
250: 		if (nullCheck == null) {
251: 			// @NonNull applied to a primitive. Kinda pointless. Let's generate a warning.
252: 			source.addWarning("@NonNull is meaningless on a primitive.");
253: 			return;
254: 		}
255: 		
256: 		List<JCStatement> statements = method.body.stats;
257: 		
258: 		String expectedName = paramNode.getName();
259: 		
260: 		/* Abort if the null check is already there, delving into try and synchronized statements */ {
261: 			List<JCStatement> stats = statements;
262: 			int idx = 0;
263: 			while (stats.size() > idx) {
264: 				JCStatement stat = stats.get(idx++);
265: 				if (JavacHandlerUtil.isConstructorCall(stat)) continue;
266: 				if (stat instanceof JCTry) {
267: 					stats = ((JCTry) stat).body.stats;
268: 					idx = 0;
269: 					continue;
270: 				}
271: 				if (stat instanceof JCSynchronized) {
272: 					stats = ((JCSynchronized) stat).body.stats;
273: 					idx = 0;
274: 					continue;
275: 				}
276: 				String varNameOfNullCheck = returnVarNameIfNullCheck(stat);
277: 				if (varNameOfNullCheck == null) break;
278: 				if (varNameOfNullCheck.equals(expectedName)) return;
279: 			}
280: 		}
281: 		
282: 		List<JCStatement> tail = statements;
283: 		List<JCStatement> head = List.nil();
284: 		for (JCStatement stat : statements) {
285: 			if (JavacHandlerUtil.isConstructorCall(stat) || (JavacHandlerUtil.isGenerated(stat) && isNullCheck(stat))) {
286: 				tail = tail.tail;
287: 				head = head.prepend(stat);
288: 				continue;
289: 			}
290: 			break;
291: 		}
292: 		
293: 		List<JCStatement> newList = tail.prepend(nullCheck);
294: 		for (JCStatement stat : head) newList = newList.prepend(stat);
295: 		method.body.stats = newList;
296: 		source.getAst().setChanged();
297: 	}

299: 	@Override public void handle(AnnotationValues<NonNull> annotation, JCAnnotation ast, JavacNode annotationNode) {
300: 		handleFlagUsage(annotationNode, ConfigurationKeys.NON_NULL_FLAG_USAGE, "@NonNull");
301: 		if (annotationNode.up().getKind() == Kind.FIELD) {
302: 			// This is meaningless unless the field is used to generate a method (@Setter, @RequiredArgsConstructor, etc),
303: 			// but in that case those handlers will take care of it. However, we DO check if the annotation is applied to
304: 			// a primitive, because those handlers trigger on any annotation named @NonNull and we only want the warning
305: 			// behaviour on _OUR_ 'lombok.NonNull'.
306: 			
307: 			try {
308: 				if (isPrimitive(((JCVariableDecl) annotationNode.up().get()).vartype)) {
309: 					annotationNode.addWarning("@NonNull is meaningless on a primitive.");
310: 				}
311: 			} catch (Exception ignore) {}
312: 			
313: 			JCVariableDecl fDecl = (JCVariableDecl) annotationNode.up().get();
314: 			if ((fDecl.mods.flags & RECORD) != 0) {
315: 				// well, these kinda double as parameters (of the compact constructor), so we do some work here.
316: 				
317: 				List<JCMethodDecl> compactConstructors = addCompactConstructorIfNeeded(annotationNode.up().up(), annotationNode);
318: 				for (JCMethodDecl ctr : compactConstructors) {
319: 					addNullCheckIfNeeded(ctr, annotationNode.up(), annotationNode);
320: 				}
321: 			}
322: 			return;
323: 		}
324: 		
325: 		JCMethodDecl declaration;
326: 		JavacNode paramNode;
327: 		
328: 		switch (annotationNode.up().getKind()) {
329: 		case ARGUMENT:
330: 			paramNode = annotationNode.up();
331: 			break;
332: 		case TYPE_USE:
333: 			JavacNode typeNode = annotationNode.directUp();
334: 			paramNode = typeNode.directUp();
335: 			break;
336: 		default:
337: 			return;
338: 		}
339: 		
340: 		if (paramNode.getKind() != Kind.ARGUMENT) return;
341: 		try {
342: 			declaration = (JCMethodDecl) paramNode.up().get();
343: 		} catch (Exception e) {
344: 			return;
345: 		}
346: 		
347: 		if (declaration.body == null) {
348: 			// This used to be a warning, but as @NonNull also has a documentary purpose, better to not warn about this. Since 1.16.7
349: 			return;
350: 		}
351: 		
352: 		if ((declaration.mods.flags & (GENERATED_MEMBER | COMPACT_RECORD_CONSTRUCTOR)) != 0) {
353: 			// The 'real' annotations are on the `record Foo(@NonNull Obj x)` part and we just see these
354: 			// syntax-sugared over. We deal with it on the field declaration variant, as those are always there,
355: 			// not dependent on whether you write out the compact constructor or not.
356: 			return;
357: 		}
358: 		
359: 		addNullCheckIfNeeded(declaration, paramNode, annotationNode);
360: 	}

362: 	public boolean isNullCheck(JCStatement stat) {
363: 		return returnVarNameIfNullCheck(stat) != null;
364: 	}
365: 	
366: 	/**
367: 	 * Checks if the statement is of the form 'if (x == null) {throw WHATEVER;}' or 'assert x != null;',
368: 	 * where the block braces are optional. If it is of this form, returns "x".
369: 	 * If it is not of this form, returns null.
370: 	 */
371: 	public String returnVarNameIfNullCheck(JCStatement stat) {
372: 		boolean isIf = stat instanceof JCIf;
373: 		boolean isExpression = stat instanceof JCExpressionStatement;
374: 		if (!isIf && !(stat instanceof JCAssert) && !isExpression) return null;
375: 		
376: 		if (isExpression) {
377: 			/* Check if the statements contains a call to checkNotNull or requireNonNull */
378: 			JCExpression expression = ((JCExpressionStatement) stat).expr;
379: 			if (expression instanceof JCAssign) expression = ((JCAssign) expression).rhs;
380: 			if (!(expression instanceof JCMethodInvocation)) return null;
381: 			
382: 			JCMethodInvocation invocation = (JCMethodInvocation) expression;
383: 			JCExpression method = invocation.meth;
384: 			Name name = null;
385: 			if (method instanceof JCFieldAccess) {
386: 				name = ((JCFieldAccess) method).name;
387: 			} else if (method instanceof JCIdent) {
388: 				name = ((JCIdent) method).name;
389: 			}
390: 			if (name == null || (!name.contentEquals(CHECK_NOT_NULL) && !name.contentEquals(REQUIRE_NON_NULL))) return null;
391: 			
392: 			if (invocation.args.isEmpty()) return null;
393: 			JCExpression firstArgument = invocation.args.head;
394: 			if (!(firstArgument instanceof JCIdent)) return null;
395: 			return ((JCIdent) firstArgument).toString();
396: 		}
397: 		
398: 		if (isIf) {
399: 			/* Check that the if's statement is a throw statement, possibly in a block. */
400: 			JCStatement then = ((JCIf) stat).thenpart;
401: 			if (then instanceof JCBlock) {
402: 				List<JCStatement> stats = ((JCBlock) then).stats;
403: 				if (stats.length() == 0) return null;
404: 				then = stats.get(0);
405: 			}
406: 			if (!(then instanceof JCThrow)) return null;
407: 		}
408: 		
409: 		/* Check that the if's conditional is like 'x == null'. Return from this method (don't generate
410: 		   a nullcheck) if 'x' is equal to our own variable's name: There's already a nullcheck here. */ {
411: 			JCExpression cond = isIf ? ((JCIf) stat).cond : ((JCAssert) stat).cond;
412: 			while (cond instanceof JCParens) cond = ((JCParens) cond).expr;
413: 			if (!(cond instanceof JCBinary)) return null;
414: 			JCBinary bin = (JCBinary) cond;
415: 			if (isIf) {
416: 				if (!CTC_EQUAL.equals(treeTag(bin))) return null;
417: 			} else {
418: 				if (!CTC_NOT_EQUAL.equals(treeTag(bin))) return null;
419: 			}
420: 			if (!(bin.lhs instanceof JCIdent)) return null;
421: 			if (!(bin.rhs instanceof JCLiteral)) return null;
422: 			if (!CTC_BOT.equals(typeTag(bin.rhs))) return null;
423: 			return ((JCIdent) bin.lhs).name.toString();
424: 		}
425: 	}

Implemented the javac `@NonNull` record-component handling fix in `src/core/lombok/javac/handlers/HandleNonNull.java`.

Type-use annotations attached to a record component’s outer declared type now generate null checks through the compact record constructor. This fixes `byte @NonNull[] bytes` while avoiding checks for annotations on nested array dimensions such as `int[] @NonNull[]`.
